description: This Java interface defines immutable message headers used in the Eclipse Ditto project, including methods for constructing, accessing, and manipulating message header properties such as direction, subject, thing ID, content type, timeout, timestamp, and status code.

classes.name: MessageHeaders
classes.description: Immutable interface representing headers for messages, providing methods to create, access, and manipulate message header data.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for MessageHeaders with specified message direction, thing ID, and subject.

methods.name: newBuilderForClaiming
methods.description: Creates a new builder for claim messages for a specified thing ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeaders instance from a map of header key-value pairs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeaders instance from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder pre-initialized with the current message headers for modification.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the message, indicating if it is from or to a Thing.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed Thing ID associated with the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID involved in the message, if any.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the payload's content type, if specified.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp indicating when the message was created.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code associated with the message.
